description: Header file defining pointwise tensor operations for Torch's JIT tensor expression module, including compute functions for sign, one to four operand operations, conditionals, no-ops, and scalar computations.

methods.name: computeSign
methods.description: Computes the sign of input tensor.

methods.name: computeOneOperand
methods.description: Performs a unary tensor operation with a custom inner expression.

methods.name: computeTwoOperand
methods.description: Performs a binary tensor operation with a custom inner expression.

methods.name: computeTwoOperandWithAlpha
methods.description: Performs a binary tensor operation with an alpha parameter and a custom inner expression.

methods.name: computeConditionWithTwoOperand
methods.description: Performs a conditional tensor operation with two operands.

methods.name: computeThreeOperand
methods.description: Performs a ternary tensor operation with a custom inner expression.

methods.name: computeFourOperand
methods.description: Performs a four-operand tensor operation with a custom inner expression.

methods.name: computeScalar
methods.description: Computes a scalar value based on input arguments and an inner expression.
